title: AI Generalist
description:
**Experience:**

**About Riverfront** 




 Riverfront is independent behavioral validation for AI agents. We test agents through their real interface, the way a user or regulator would, and produce evidence that boards, auditors, and regulators can rely on. Our methodology is aligned to the frameworks regulators are writing (EU AI Act, GDPR, UAE PDPL, Colorado AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001\), and it's versioned end to end, so any result can be reproduced and defended months later.
 



  





  





 We work in a spec\-driven, AI\-orchestrated model where the quality of your thinking matters more than your typing speed. We're looking for people who can understand ambiguous problems, make sound technical decisions, and build.
 



  





**Location:** 
  Pune, India/Dubai, UAE
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will own complex problems from brief to delivery \- understanding the problem, turning it into a precise spec, making architectural decisions, building alongside the team, and shipping with confidence.
 



**This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant ownership.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* Turn complex product and client requirements into structured technical specs before development begins
* Architect and build agentic AI systems end to end \- including RAG pipelines, multi\-agent orchestration, MCP\-based integrations, tool\-use workflows, and memory
* Make architecture decisions across model selection, retrieval strategy, memory design, and orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, and AutoGen
* Own performance and cost trade\-offs across token usage, latency, inference quality, and LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, and AWS Bedrock
* Build observability and evaluation systems using tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Helicone, Arize, and W\&B
* Define evaluation criteria and determine what "good" actually means for an AI agent
* Contribute directly to Riverfront's AI governance and evaluation platform
* Participate in solution design, technical decisions, and product delivery
* Review other developers' work and identify weak assumptions or shallow planning early
* Join client and stakeholder conversations when needed and explain technical decisions clearly
* Help evolve the spec\-driven development practices the team uses as we scale



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**You have around 2\-3 years of hands\-on engineering experience** 
 , ideally in a product company, technical consultancy, startup, or agency where you have had real ownership.
 



 More importantly, you have 
 **shipped AI systems beyond the prototype stage** 
 .
 



 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Agentic and multi\-agent AI systems with real tool use and memory
* RAG pipelines and retrieval architecture
* Vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Qdrant, or Milvus
* Backend engineering \- APIs, microservices, asynchronous systems, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD
* Modern LLM providers and model\-selection trade\-offs
* AI\-assisted development using tools such as Claude Code or Cursor



 You have written specs or requirements documents, made architectural decisions, and stood behind them. You are comfortable working directly with product leadership, clients, or other stakeholders rather than operating only from a ticket queue.
 



 You ask difficult questions before you start building and document important decisions as you go.
 



**This role is for someone who wants to stay deeply hands\-on \- building, experimenting, making technical decisions, and owning outcomes. It is not designed as a short path into people management.** 









**What You'll Get** 



* Meaningful ownership from day one
* Direct involvement in product and technical decisions
* Work on AI systems that are actually being deployed and evaluated in production
* Exposure across agentic AI, AI governance, evaluation, and enterprise AI
* The opportunity to help shape both the product and the engineering practices behind it
* Competitive compensation based on experience and location

 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.

 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.
* Balance immediate customer requirements with long\-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.
* Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.
* Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.
* Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.
* Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.
* Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.
* Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Serve as the regional escalation point for complex implementation issues, critical customer incidents, architecture concerns, and unresolved Level 2 support cases and provide advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation guidance for issues involving Litmus products, customer infrastructure, networks, integrations, data flows, and industrial systems.
* Support Sales Engineers and Account Executives with architecture reviews, technical strategy, proposal development, scope validation, and implementation risk assessment.
* Provide senior technical oversight during the transition from pre\-sales to implementation.


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* 10–15 years of progressive experience in application engineering, solution architecture, systems integration, technical consulting, customer success engineering, industrial technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading complex software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, edge\-computing, or shop\-floor implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, architecture oversight, design approval, and implementation governance across multiple simultaneous customer engagements.
* Experience directing or overseeing the work of engineers, including setting technical priorities, reviewing deliverables, mentoring team members, and making technical decisions.
* Strong understanding of industrial and enterprise solution architecture, including networks, security, protocols, Linux\-based systems, databases, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed deployment environments.
* Deep hands\-on experience with product configuration, systems integration, technical troubleshooting, performance analysis, root\-cause analysis, and production support.
* Strong customer\-facing skills, including the ability to lead architecture workshops, explain complex technical concepts, manage technical objections, and communicate risk clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, engineers, sales teams, partners, product leaders, and executives.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.
* Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity practices for operational technology, industrial networks, edge devices, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience supporting regulated, mission\-critical, or high\-availability customer environments.
* Experience with pre\-sales architecture, technical discovery, proposal approval, statement\-of\-work review, RFI/RFP responses, and commercial scope validation.
* Experience working with systems integrators, channel partners, value\-added resellers, and regional technology partners.
* Experience contributing to product roadmaps, design reviews, beta programs, technical validation, or release\-readiness processes.
* Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, implementation methodologies, and reusable engineering assets.
* Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, or solution architecture.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Measures of Success**
* Quality, consistency, and scalability of APAC customer implementations.
* Successful delivery of strategic proof\-of\-concept and production engagements.
* Reduction in implementation risk, technical rework, escalations, and recurring support issues.
* Timeliness and quality of regional technical decisions and approvals.
* Customer adoption, value realization, satisfaction, and expansion.
* Development and technical readiness of Application Engineers.
* Adoption of regional and global delivery standards, reusable assets, and best practices.
* Effectiveness of pre\-sales\-to\-delivery handovers and technical scope validation.
* Quality and influence of APAC field feedback provided to Product Management and Development.
* Ability to balance customer priorities, team capacity, delivery commitments, and long\-term technical quality.

* Establish a trusted data model and source\-of\-truth hierarchy for custodian identity and source coverage, with explicit provenance, effective dating, confidence, exception handling, and full traceability of why an identification or downstream task was produced.
* Design services and configuration capabilities that reduce hard\-coded change, enable controlled onboarding and offboarding of applications and data sources, and expose reusable capabilities to EDI and other approved consumers through secure APIs and events.
* Build end\-to\-end auditability into the platform, capturing data lineage, rule versions, decision context, user and system actions, overrides, approvals, and evidence needed to explain and defend identification outcomes.

* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, Data Governance, Compliance, and operations teams to ensure designs meet requirements for access control, encryption, retention, residency, resilience, disaster recovery, change governance, and production evidence.
* Drive incremental delivery through proofs of concept, walking skeletons, reusable platform components, automated tests, and measurable migration outcomes rather than producing architecture artifacts without executable implementation.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong relational database engineering and advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, analytical functions, execution plan analysis, indexing, data modeling, stored procedures, and performance tuning; strong PL/SQL knowledge is highly desirable.
* Hands\-on Java expertise, including modern Java, object\-oriented and functional design, collections, concurrency, JVM internals, memory and performance tuning, exception handling, dependency management, and production debugging.
* Good practical Python coding knowledge for data processing, automation, validation, orchestration, utilities, and integration, with the ability to review Python design and code quality even though Java is the primary engineering skill.

* Proven ability to lead complex technical designs and influence experienced engineers through clear architecture reasoning, code\-level credibility, constructive challenge, and practical implementation guidance.
* Strong data\-platform engineering experience across both on\-premise and cloud environments, including ingestion, transformation, data quality, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, effective\-dated data, and governed publication of trusted datasets.
* Hands\-on GCP data\-platform experience with BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run and/or GKE, together with sound judgment on when each service is appropriate.
* Experience re\-architecting or modernizing a legacy, business\-critical application through phased decomposition, coexistence, migration, dual run, reconciliation, and controlled cutover rather than a single high\-risk rewrite.
* Strong API\-first and metadata\-driven design capability, including service contracts, versioning, idempotency, schema evolution, backward compatibility, error models, and secure system integration.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling for identity, configuration, historical and relationship data, including normalization, dimensional or analytical models where appropriate, provenance, effective dating, and source\-of\-truth rules.
